description: A utility class providing common functions for LoRa provider operations, including validation of LoRa gateways, URL normalization, encoding conversions, and configuration extraction.

classes.name: LoraUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for LoRa gateway validation, URL handling, encoding conversions, and configuration extraction.

methods.name: isValidLoraGateway
methods.description: Validates if a JSON object represents a valid LoRa gateway based on required fields and value constraints.

methods.name: getNormalizedProviderUrlFromGatewayDevice
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the LoRa provider URL from a gateway device JSON object, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: convertFromHexToBase64
methods.description: Converts a hex-encoded string to its Base64 representation, throwing an exception if input is invalid.

methods.name: convertFromBase64ToHex
methods.description: Converts a Base64-encoded string to its hex representation, throwing an exception if input is invalid.

methods.name: convertToHexString
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a hex string.

methods.name: getLoraConfigFromLoraGatewayDevice
methods.description: Extracts the LoRa configuration JSON object from a gateway device JSON object.

methods.name: isHttpSuccessStatusCode
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates success (2xx).

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a string is null, empty, or whitespace only.
